adaptation: Original hierarchical SAD block matching, coarse-neighbour seeds, parabolic subpixel fit and component median mapped to existing native Compute ABI; no Rayon/foreign Renderer dependency.
Original Flow::at and forward/backward two-frame warp mapped to typed motion fields and existing guarded Pair sampler.
Uses actual image-derived pyramid depth rather than original fixed4-level cap; rejects windows/spacing that cannot fit source instead of silently returning zero flow.
Search beyond clamped image support is pruned by actual level dimensions/window, not a permanent user-facing motion cap.
Time Displacement streams source images and uses existing guarded Pair hi/lo storage; published once at selected F16/F32 precision.
Motion vector blur uses existing compensated temporal reducer and streamed pixel warps; no unbounded single-dispatch shutter loop.
Alpha conversion retains valid PM zero-Alpha emission; Straight hidden RGB is zeroed.
cpuReference: Selected original Rust block, only rayon iterators replaced with serial std iterators; tests only.
runtime: One existing native GPU owner; no CPU image fallback, SDR8 bridge, timeline, scheduler, professional document schema or package manager.
